verdict.rationale: Zapier exposes APIs, including the Workflow API and a /stored-actions endpoint, so a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question. However, the pack documents no such spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt docs index is machine-readable documentation, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
